licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 211–215, bars 1–99 of No. 19
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in two page ranges, pp. 211–213 and 214–215), a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by two fresh checkers (bars 1–60 clean; in bars 61–99 one error found and corrected: in bars 69 and 73 the D–B on “vo-” is one syllable, so the following syllables each move one note later). The German singing translation is left out. Andante to bar 21, Allegretto from bar 22. Kept as printed: the E sharp and G sharp chords in bars 34–36 and 64–66. The cut signs at “vi-” (bar 36) and “-de” (bar 66) are not written in the score. Playback tempo ♩ = 60, and a dotted quarter = 65 (♩ = 97) from the Allegretto (bar 22), from Jacobs (3:28); Mozart gives the words only.
